description: This file contains test functions for the Android Cuttlefish project, specifically testing power button functionalities by interacting with device display states and executing adb commands.

methods.name: TestPowerBtn
methods.description: Tests the power button functionality by toggling the device screen off and on.

methods.name: TestPowerBtnNoHostTool
methods.description: Tests power button behavior when the host tool is removed, verifying screen state toggling.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Helper function to upload necessary artifacts and create a device instance.

methods.name: readScreenStateLine
methods.description: Reads the line indicating screen state from the device's dumpsys display output via adb commands.
